referenceFunction.generalComment: Refers to 1 kg dry matter of fresh grass from intensive IP production with 1.66 kg CO2 and 17.9 MJ per kg dry matter. The dry matter content of fresh gras is about 10-15% ; UUID: a97b5600-4d88-326c-ab6b-db2a1ebfe5c6
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventories include the cultivation of grass on a permanent meadow. Included steps are fertilisation (slurry and ammonium nitrate), harvest, loading for transport.
referenceFunction.localName: Grass from natural meadow intensive IP, at field
referenceFunction.name: Grass from natural meadow intensive IP, at field

geography.text: Refers to a production in the Swiss plateau (lowlands <700m).

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Data were compiled from statistics, fertilising recommendations, documents from extension services and expert knowledge.
